import json, os, psycopg
from wuji_core.admission.registry import publish_task_admission

config = json.load(open('/run/wuji/bootstrap/config.json'))
params = dict(config['database'])
params.update(user='wuji_migration', password=config['roles']['wuji_migration'])
task_id = os.environ['TARGET_TASK']
fixture = os.environ['FIXTURE_TASK']
owner = (*config['owner'][:2], task_id)

with psycopg.connect(**params, sslmode='verify-full', sslrootcert=config['ca_file'], connect_timeout=5, autocommit=True) as connection:
    definition = json.loads(connection.execute(
        "SELECT definition_json FROM vnext.task WHERE task_id=%s", (task_id,)).fetchone()[0])
    runtime = definition['runtime_profile']
    admission = {"model": definition['model_profile'], "runtime": runtime,
                 "allowed_tool_refs": runtime['allowed_tool_refs']}
    pools = [row[0] for row in connection.execute(
        "SELECT pool_key FROM vnext.task_capacity_pool WHERE task_id=%s ORDER BY pool_key", (fixture,)).fetchall()]
    grants = []
    for row in connection.execute(
        """SELECT subject,can_read,can_write,can_capture,can_settle,can_gc,can_assess,
        can_control,can_observe,can_admit,clearance FROM vnext.task_access
        WHERE task_id=%s AND subject<>'operator' ORDER BY subject""", (fixture,)).fetchall():
        grants.append({"subject": row[0], "can_read": row[1], "can_write": row[2],
                       "can_capture": row[3], "can_settle": row[4], "can_gc": row[5],
                       "can_assess": row[6], "can_control": row[7], "can_observe": row[8],
                       "can_admit": row[9], "clearance": row[10]})
    template = connection.execute(
        """SELECT template_ref,issuer,audience,signing_key_ref,signing_kid,
        encryption_key_ref,clearance FROM vnext.scheduler_identity_template
        WHERE task_id=%s""", (fixture,)).fetchone()
    controller = connection.execute(
        "SELECT controller_subject,login_role FROM vnext.task_pod_controller WHERE task_id=%s",
        (fixture,)).fetchone()
    publish_task_admission(
        connection,
        owner=owner,
        admission=admission,
        capacity_pool_keys=pools,
        access_grants=grants,
        scheduler_identity={"template_ref": template[0], "issuer": template[1],
                            "audience": template[2], "signing_key_ref": template[3],
                            "signing_kid": template[4], "encryption_key_ref": template[5],
                            "clearance": template[6]},
        pod_controller={"controller_subject": controller[0], "login_role": controller[1]},
    )
    print(json.dumps({
        "event": "task_admission_published", "task_id": task_id,
        "pools": pools, "grants": [g["subject"] for g in grants],
        "template": template[0], "controller": controller[0],
        "admission_config": connection.execute(
            "SELECT count(*) FROM vnext.admission_config WHERE task_id=%s", (task_id,)).fetchone()[0],
    }))
